note: Ready-made command packs for remotes the built-in encoder cannot generate. Each entry points at a file in this folder; the browser installs it by posting each command to /api/import.

presets.notes: Captured from a real unit. Not supported by IRremoteESP8266: the frame is 72 bits over a 6.7/3.3 ms header, which matches no protocol in the library. Covers 16-28 C, power on/off, eco, turbo and lamp.
